greeting: Egameni likaYise, nelikaNyana, nelikaMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube noxolo lweNkosi yethu uYesu Krestu kunye nani nonke.
penitential: Nkosi, usivele imfesane. Krestu, usivele imfesane. Nkosi, usivele imfesane.
homily:
Khumbula umzuzu othi cwaka, apho uBenjamin Vo wayemi phambi kwesibuko okanye ecaleni kwikhompyutha yakhe, ebonakala ngathi ucinga ngento enkulu kakhulu. Wayengumfana owayethanda ukwazi ukuba izinto zisebenza njani—ukusuka kwizindiza ezinkulu eziphaphayo ukuze zithwale abantu, ukuya kwikhowudi yomdlalo awayeyila ngothando. Khumbula loo mfana owayesoloko enoncumo, owayenentliziyo eyayisoloko ikulungele ukunika, nokuba yayiyimbono yakhe yokuqala inkampani, okanye umnqweno wakhe wokunika konke awayenako ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam. UBen wayengumntu owayesazi ukuba ubomi, ngaphezu kwayo yonke into, bubudlelwane obunzulu phakathi kwabantu nangoThixo.

Namhlanje, uPawulos oNgcwele usinika umfanekiso onamandla kwincwadi yakhe eya kwabaseKorinte. Uthi: 'What you sow is not brought to life unless it dies.' Le yimfihlakalo yembewu. Uthi xa sityala, asityali umzimba oza kuvela, kodwa sityala imbewu encinci, mhlawumbi yengqolowa. Le mbewu kufuneka ife ukuze ikhule ibe yinto entsha, eqaqambileyo, neyomeleleyo. UBen wayeyimbewu enjalo. Wayengumfana owayephila ngothando, kodwa ngoku, ubomi bakhe busikhumbuza ukuba ubomi bethu abupheleli apha emhlabeni. UBen utyalwe emhlabeni ngendlela yomzimba, kodwa uya kuvuka ngendlela yomoya—ngomzimba oqaqambileyo, onamandla, nowonwabileyo phambi koThixo.

Kodwa masime apha. Masithethe inyaniso. Sekuphele iinyanga ezintathu uBen esishiye. Iinyanga ezintathu zokuziva ukuba indlu ithule kakhulu. Alan noThao, ndiyazi ukuba usizi luyinto enzima, ngakumbi xa ucinga ngaloo mntwana wakho owayekuthanda kakhulu, owayekulalele xa ubalisa amabali akho, owayekuthanda kakhulu njengoba wayekuthanda ukuhamba nawe, Ryan. Usizi aluhambi ngokwekhalenda. Niyazibuza ukuba kwenzeke ntoni. Niyazibuza ukuba kutheni lo mfana owayephila ngothando, owayephila ngobubele, kufuneka ahambe ngolu hlobo. Niyazibuza ukuba kukhona na eninokukwenza ngcono. Ndicela niphulaphule: Ukugula akulona iphutha lenu. Akukho nto eniyenze ngendlela engalunganga. UThixo akakubeki icala, kwaye noBen akakubeki icala. Susa lowo mthwalo wokuzisola egxalabeni lakho. Awuphosanga nto. Ubenze konke okusemandleni enu ngothando olungapheliyo.

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, uYesu uthetha ngesihlwayi esityala imbewu. Ezinye ziwela endleleni, ezinye ematyeni, ezinye emithanini, kodwa ezinye ziwela emhlabeni otyebileyo. UBen wayeyimbewu ewela emhlabeni otyebileyo. Wayeyamkela ilizwi likaThixo ngentliziyo enesisa, kwaye wayevelisa isiqhamo ngonyamezelo. UBen wayeyindoda encane eyayakha isiseko sayo edwaleni. Ukholo lwakhe, ububele bakhe, uthando lwakhe—konke oku kwakuyisiseko esomeleleyo. Xa isiphango sezifo size, loo ndlu ayizange iwe, kuba yayakhiwe kakuhle.

Ryan, mfowethu omncane, uBen uyamthanda. Ungalokothi uzive ungedwa. UBen uyaqhubeka ekukhathalele. Qhubeka uphila ngesibindi, ube ngumfana owayeyiyo—onemfesane, onobubele, nonesibindi. UBen uyaqhubeka ekhanya ngomsebenzi wakhe wothando, njengaloo mthombo wamanzi eCà Mau, olethela ubomi kwabanye. Uthando lwakhe aluzange luphele; lusaqhubeka lugeza umhlaba njengolwandle olukhulu. Nani, Alan noThao, ningayeki ukuthanda. Nithandeke kakhulu nguThixo. UBen wayengumfana onikela ngayo yonke into yakhe. Nani, nikani konke usizi lwenu kuThixo. Musani ukuzama ukuluthwala lodwa. Vumelani uYesu ukuba abe lulwalwa lwenu.

Xa uziva usizi, yithi: 'Nkosi, ndiyakuthanda, kwaye ndiyakuthemba.' UBen uyaqhubeka esidumisela kuThixo. Uthando lwenu luyaqhubeka luhleli, lusaqhubeka lukhula, kwaye uBen uyaqhubeka ekhanya. Benjamin, lala ngokuthula. Uthando lwakho lulukhanya olungasoze lwavaleleka. Uthando lwakho, njengaloo mthombo wamanzi, luyaqhubeka luhleli, lusaqhubeka lukhula, kwaye luyaqhubeka lukhanyisa iindlela zethu. Khumbula ukuba uBen uyaqhubeka esidumisela kuThixo, kwaye nathi, simele siphile ngaloo ndlela—ngothando olungagciniyo, ngoxolelo olungapheliyo, nangokholo olomeleleyo. Benjamin, lala ngokuthula. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu Krestu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona ngenene kwiSakramente engcwele. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwayo yonke into, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Ekubeni ndingenakukwamkela ngoku ngokwasemzimbeni, nceda uze emphefumlweni wam ngomoya. Ndiyakwamkela njengokungathi sele ulapha, ndize ndizibophelele ngokupheleleyo kuwe. Ungaze uvumele ukuba ndahlukane nawe. Amen.
closing: Ngamana uThixo onamandla angakusikelela, akugcine, kwaye akuphathe ngoxolo lwakhe olungapheliyo. Hamba ngoxolo.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBen nabo bonke abashiyileyo, ukuze baphumle elukhanyeni lukaKrestu ngonaphakade.
Sithandazela bonke abasemlilweni wosizi, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele abanike ithemba eliqinileyo.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Bazalwana, mhlawumbi umntu angabuza esithi, 'Abafileyo bavuswa njani? Baza kuza ngamzimba onjani?' Siyathanda wena! Into oyityalayo ayiphili ngaphandle kokuba ife. Kwaye into oyityalayo ayingomzimba oza kubakho, kodwa yimbewu yengqolowa, okanye yezinye iintlobo. Kunjalo nangovuko lwabafileyo. Ityalwa ibolayo, ivuswa ingaboli. Ityalwa ihlazekile, ivuswa izukile. Ityalwa ibuthathaka, ivuswa inamandla. Ityalwa ingumzimba wendalo, ivuswa ingumzimba womoya. Ukuba kukho umzimba wendalo, kukho nomzimba womoya. Kunjalo ke njengokuba kubhaliwe, 'Umntu wokuqala, uAdam, waba ngumphefumlo ophilayo,' uAdam wokugqibela waba ngumoya ophilisa. Kodwa okomoya akuzanga kuqala; kuqale okwendalo, kwaza kwalandela okomoya. Umntu wokuqala wayephuma emhlabeni, engowasemhlabeni; owesibini wayephuma ezulwini. Njengokuba kunjalo ngowasemhlabeni, kunjalo nabo basemhlabeni; njengokuba kunjalo ngowasezulwini, kunjalo nabo basezulwini. Njengokuba sithwele umfanekiso walowo wasemhlabeni, siya kuthwala nomfanekiso walowo wasezulwini.

readings.label: INdumiso
readings.text: R. Ndohamba phambi koThixo, ekukhanyeni kwabaphilayo. Ngoku ndiyazi ukuba uThixo unam. KuThixo, endithemba isithembiso sakhe, kuThixo ndithemba ngaphandle koloyiko; ingaba inyama ingandenza ntoni? R. Ndohamba phambi koThixo, ekukhanyeni kwabaphilayo. Ndingqale, O Thixo, ngezifungo kuwe; ndozizalisa iminikelo yakho yombulelo. Kuba undihlangule ekufeni, neenyawo zam ekukhubekeni; ukuze ndihambe phambi koThixo ekukhanyeni kwabaphilayo. R. Ndohamba phambi koThixo, ekukhanyeni kwabaphilayo.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: Xa isihlwele esikhulu sasibuthene, abantu besiza kwidolophu ngedolophu besiya kuYesu, wathetha ngomzekeliso. 'Umtshali waphuma waya kutyala imbewu yakhe. Njengokuba wayetyala, enye yawela endleleni yanyathelwa, iintaka zezulu zayitya. Enye yawela ematyeni, yakukhula yoma ngenxa yokuswela ukufuma. Enye yawela phakathi kwameva, ameva akhula nayo ayikrwitsha. Enye yawela emhlabeni otyebileyo, yakukhula yavelisa isiqhamo ngamakhulu.' Emva kokuthetha oku, wamemeza wathi, 'Lowo unendlebe zokuva makave.' Abafundi bakhe bambuza ukuba lo mzekeliso uthetha ukuthini. Waphendula wathi, 'Ukwazi iimfihlakalo zoBukumkani bukaThixo kunikiwe nina; kodwa kwabanye, kwenziwa ngemizekeliso ukuze babukele kodwa bangaboni, bave kodwa bangaqondi. Nantsi intsingiselo yomzekeliso. Imbewu lilizwi likaThixo. Abo basendleleni ngabo bevileyo, kodwa uSathana uza asuse ilizwi ezintliziyweni zabo ukuze bangakholwa basindiswe. Abo basematyeni ngabo, xa bevile, balamkela ilizwi ngovuyo, kodwa abanangcambu; bakholwa okwethutyana, kodwa xa kufika isilingo bayawa. Imbewu ewela phakathi kwameva ngabo bevileyo, kodwa njengoko behamba, bakrwitshwa ziinkxalabo nobutyebi kunye nemincili yobomi, baze bangavelisi siqhamo esivuthiweyo. Kodwa imbewu ewela emhlabeni otyebileyo ngabo, xa bevile ilizwi, balamkela ngentliziyo enesisa nelungileyo, baze bavelise isiqhamo ngokunyamezela.'

day: Saturday of the Twenty-fourth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.

Ben ơi, ba nhớ con nhiều quá.

Mommy cũng vậy. Hơn hai tháng rồi mà ba má vẫn khóc mỗi ngày.

Con giúp ba má vượt qua nha, để lo cho em
Hey Ben,  nếu có thể hãy cho anh Minh gặp Ben trong giấc mơ nhé, dù chỉ là lời chào hay nụ cười như cách Ben vẫn hay tạo dáng để chụp hình. Nhớ và thương Ben nhiều lắm
